sources.title: VoxCPM2 | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: VoxCPM2 is OpenBMB's open-source tokenizer-free multilingual text-to-speech model for natural speech generation, voice design, and controllable voice cloning. It is a 2B-parameter model trained on over 2 million hours of speech, supports 30 languages, and produces 48 kHz studio-quality audio with real-time streaming capability.
